|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]] (original, release sheet of 12 March 2010); [[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]]): Virtual Block 6.3 (Mercenaries) release sheet, released 12 March 2010<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>, official text as of 15 March 2010<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010), page 4, slip 317. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May deploy as a 'react.' Permanent pilot is •Jendon who provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Onyx 1. Adds one battle destiny if with Onyx 2. Immune to attrition < 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-17-Colonel_Jendon_In_Onyx_1.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-coloneljendoninonyx1-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 53) prints this text again, identical character for character<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=53, page 53. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=53 Internet Archive]</ref>. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “3•17” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, on the Virtual Block 6 list and the Virtual master list in every archived capture from 21 July 2012 (the earliest with game text) to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1263_17">Players Committee website card list: VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “May deploy as a 'react.' Permanent pilot is •Jendon, who provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Onyx 1. Adds one battle destiny if with Onyx 2. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' a comma is added after “•Jendon” (“Permanent pilot is •Jendon, who provides”). The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes. The list also prints the concept credit as text and writes the title “Colonel Jendon in Onyx 1” with a lower-case “in”. The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-coloneljendoninonyx1-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]]) again, word for word: “May deploy as a 'react.' Permanent pilot is •Jendon who provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Onyx 1. Adds one battle destiny if with Onyx 2. Immune to attrition < 4.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “3•17” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 53)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]]) again, word for word: “May deploy as a 'react.' Permanent pilot is •Jendon who provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Onyx 1. Adds one battle destiny if with Onyx 2. Immune to attrition < 4.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1263-17-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “3•17”).
